name: Montgomery County, PA
findings: Montgomery County has 3,524 nonprofit organizations. 1,606 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,357 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montgomery County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
